Game Overview

In Jump or Die, the core idea is straightforward: leap into the intense world of Jump or Die, where quick reflexes decide survival. Master the art of perfectly timed jumps to avoid unpredictable obstacles in a relentless quest for the highest score. Every leap is a daring challenge—will you conquer the ultimate test of nerves?
